# Messages from the same reference that must NOT park the quota gate: spend
# caps and API throttles are not the subscription windows (ADR-0002), and a
# warning is not a stop.

API Error: Request rejected (429) · this may be a temporary capacity issue. If it persists, check https://status.claude.com.
API Error: Server is temporarily limiting requests (not your usage limit)
You've used 85% of your session limit · resets 3:45pm
